description: cockroachdb/migrations/*.sql are generated for manual CockroachDB Cloud upload via `npm run crdb:prepare-upload-sql` (source: supabase/migrations). For CLI apply to a live cluster, use `npm run crdb:apply-migrations` (reads supabase/migrations directly).
note: skippedOnCockroachDb in v2 entries referred to the old apply runner; only extreme_performance_hardening is still skipped when applying from supabase/migrations.
